title: Chronicon, Book I (Chronographia), Armenian version; RU: «Хроника» Евсевия, кн. I
author: Eusebius of Caesarea
language: Classical Armenian (Greek lost apart from fragments)
genre: Chronography with excerpts from lost historians
edition: Aucher 1818 (Armenian + Latin + Greek, public domain, archive.org); Schoene–Petermann 1875 (public domain); Karst 1911 (GCS, German, public domain).
ru_evidence: ru.wiki «Хроника Евсевия»: only partial Russian translations (the Roman part, via Jerome, Kiev 1910). ancientrome.ru has only a list of Ptolemies (translated from English) and the Berossus fragments.
en_evidence: Andrew Smith, attalus.org/translate/eusebius.html (from the Schoene Latin), covering all of Book I.
value: Preserves excerpts from Berossus, Abydenus, Alexander Polyhistor and Manetho, and Porphyry's lists of the Macedonian, Thessalian, Ptolemaic and Seleucid kings, plus the Olympic victor list. Indispensable for Hellenistic chronology; no Russian apparatus exists.
ai_feasibility: Medium (Armenian). Strong controls exist: Greek fragments (Syncellus), Latin and German translations.
pilot_unit: Macedonian, Thessalian and Asian/Syrian kings (Porphyry excerpts), c. 6–8k words: the history after Alexander.
